title: ANOVA Wormhole
summary: Ages across decades in Python: statsmodels formulas with C(), anova_lm(), η², Tukey HSD and Welch's ANOVA.
hints: `model = smf.ols("age ~ C(decade)", data=first).fit()`, then `table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)`.
η² = SS between / SS total: `table["sum_sq"].iloc[0] / table["sum_sq"].sum()`.

`tukey = pairwise_tukeyhsd(first["age"], first["decade"])`; `welch = anova_oneway(first["age"], first["decade"], use_var="unequal")`; Levene: `stats.levene(*[g["age"] for _, g in first.groupby("decade")], center="mean")`.
